column1: # Good Job! Mac profile, checked against the 1.0.0 survey and first-level Mac bring-up.

# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a large alias region; the heap check sizes the heap region from the heap the game asks for
# Mac bring-up: reserve 9 GiB of address space, not resident memory.
# The 5 GiB provisional layout aborts in SDK 9.3.1 StandardAllocator::Initialize
# (sdk+0xc6550, caller main+0x1ac71f8) before nnMain. Its 3.14 GiB reservation,
# SDK node area and size-class alignment do not fit the provisional alias range.
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# Good Job! requests present interval 2 on Switch (30 fps). On Mac, present
# once per display tick and target 60 fps; Unity gameplay remains time-based.
